source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

original_test_intent: Verify every supported RETIMER_0 through RETIMER_7 inventory entry is readable, maps to the intended physical/PCIe retimer, and reports the correct active firmware and health/lifecycle detail in the BMC Inventory and LEDs view.
original_method: Enumerate FirmwareInventory and relevant chassis relationships, resolve each retimer through the approved PCIe topology, collect its complete read-only active/staged/updateability/status fields, correlate the WebUI records and compare the documented population and versions without invoking any update action.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the retimer population, index-to-PCIe mapping, lifecycle semantics and expected firmware matrix. The agent can then automate complete read-only collection and comparison; an engineer resolves vendor-specific states and owns acceptance.
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or call UpdateService, retimer reset, rollback, PCIe control or firmware actions.
Do not use a name substring as identity; resolve every inventory member through vendor topology and related links.
Do not use insecure TLS or expose credentials and sensitive topology identifiers.
Account independently for all eight named indices or approved absent devices; do not infer completeness from a count.
Separate active, backup and staged versions, updateability and health rather than accepting one version string.
Stop on duplicate/missing mapping, incomplete pagination or unknown lifecycle state and preserve raw evidence without retrying or changing state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, schema, retimer topology, expected firmware matrix and protected access.
Enumerate complete FirmwareInventory and exact retimer members with relationship links.
Normalize per-index identity, PCIe placement, active/staged version, status/health and updateability.
Compare every expected/absent retimer and correlate source WebUI display.
Archive raw redacted evidence and report facts without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the RETIMER_0~7 population, index/topology mapping and expected version matrix.
Approve lifecycle semantics and WebUI/API equivalence.
Review each indexed device and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The case-insensitive filter may locate candidates but cannot prove the intended eight devices, collection completeness, topology, active/staged state or UI presentation; it also bypasses TLS verification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the full protected FirmwareInventory, follow each member, bind candidates to approved retimer topology and compare complete lifecycle fields per RETIMER_0~7.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RETIMER_0~7, Inventory and LEDs WebUI, readable/correct Criterion, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use collection-driven, topology-bound per-retimer firmware inventory and WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected platform's PCIe retimer inventory model.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, Redfish schema and retimer inventory implementation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PCIe topology/retimer firmware specification and Project firmware recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact device mapping, complete collection and lifecycle interpretation with protected evidence while retaining WebUI scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A name-filtered version list is partial and cannot prove eight indexed devices or WebUI presentation; no read-only evidence may be credited as firmware-update testing.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology, population, versions, lifecycle rules and UI mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mapping can hide one stale retimer; firmware lifecycle fields may represent staged rather than running code.

project_override_considerations: Redfish inventory may supplement or replace manual WebUI inspection only with original/actual method, approval, per-device equivalence and uncovered UI coverage. A new vendor inventory tool is allowed if approved and coverage is recorded.
expected_evidence: Target identity, trusted session, complete FirmwareInventory collection/member paths and timestamps
Approved RETIMER_0~7 population and physical/PCIe topology map
Raw redacted and normalized per-retimer active/staged/updateability/status evidence
Per-index expected-version and health comparison including absent/duplicate/missing results
WebUI parity or override record, preserved logs, no-update proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently request retimer-related chassis inventory detail. DeepSeek's substring shortcut is incomplete but does not create a competing Master purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended retimer inventory and indices are clear. Platform topology and firmware expectations are normal Project readiness inputs, not irreducible semantic blockers.

review_improvement: Creates a one-to-one RETIMER_0~7 evidence matrix with actual running/staged firmware interpretation and prevents a convenient name match from concealing a missing or mis-mapped device.
independent_technical_reasoning: Retimer inventory names are labels, not proof of physical identity, and a platform can expose staged and active revisions differently. The review therefore requires relationship-based topology mapping and per-index lifecycle fields; otherwise eight similar strings can still omit a device or report non-running firmware.
